name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Growth Systems & CRM Administration | CRM Configuration, Integrations, Tracking & Reporting for Growth Teams
summary: Hands-on CRM owner and growth-systems builder. At Solenzo I am the primary administrator for client CRMs in GoHighLevel and HubSpot: pipelines, lifecycle stages, segmentation, data hygiene, 20+ automated workflows, and integrations built with webhooks, REST APIs, and OAuth in n8n, Make, and Zapier. I install GA4 and Google Tag Manager with conversion tracking and consent configuration, build dashboards in Power BI, and validate every data import into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel. Before that, 15+ years partnering with sales, marketing, and onboarding leaders at Wix, Birdeye, and Accelo, including defining the Salesforce fields our onboarding workflows ran on.

experience.title: CRM & Growth Systems Administrator — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own and administer client CRMs in GoHighLevel and HubSpot: contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead scoring and qualification criteria, and strict data-hygiene rules.
Configure 20+ automated workflows covering lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, booking with reminders, no-show follow-up, nurture, and review requests.
Build integrations in n8n, Make, and Zapier with OAuth and API-key credentials, webhooks, REST API calls, and JSON payloads; set up and validate data feeds into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel.
Install GA4 and Google Tag Manager with conversion tracking, call tracking, UTM conventions, and cookie-consent configuration; build Power BI and CRM dashboards for leadership.
Gather requirements from business owners, implement and test the solution, manage software vendors and implementation partners, train staff, and document configurations in Notion.
